_about: Operations proposed by nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b in the first live run (live.db, 2026-10-08). Recorded model output, replayed in tests to pin down failures seen live.

E1.value: 1024-point streaming FFT accelerator with AXI4-Stream in/out on Arty A7-100T. Target clock 200 MHz, must stay under 60% LUTs.
E1.rationale: New evidence defines the project goal.

E1.value: Defined goal: 1024-point streaming FFT accelerator with AXI4-Stream in/out on Arty A7-100T. Target clock 200 MHz, must stay under 60% LUTs.
E1.rationale: Setting the goal constitutes the most recent action.

E2.value: Added radix-2 DIT butterfly, twiddle ROM generator and top-level fft_core.v via commit 3f2a91c
E2.rationale: New git commit shows implementation progress on the FFT core.

E3.value: Bit-reversed output ordering missing in FFT core output causing mismatch with numpy reference for bins 512-1023.
E3.rationale: Simulation log shows failed vectors due to missing bit-reversed ordering, indicating a blocker to correct functionality.

E3.value: Simulated fft_core using tb_fft_core; 9/12 vectors failed; output bins 512-1023 mismatch numpy reference; identified missing bit-reversed output ordering.
E3.rationale: Record the simulation attempt and its outcome as historical data.

E4.value: Decision: dropping the memory-based radix-2 DIT design. Switching to a radix-2^2 single-path delay feedback (R2SDF) pipeline: natural fit for streaming and fewer multipliers. Output reorder buffer handles bit reversal.
E4.rationale: Record decision to change FFT architecture to address bit-reversal blocker.

E5.value: Implemented R2SDF pipeline (10 stages) + output reorder buffer + AXI4-Stream wrapper via commit 9c41d07
E5.rationale: New git commit adds R2SDF pipeline implementation, representing the most recent concrete action.

E6.value: Ran simulation tb_axis_fft; 10/12 PASS, backpressure_random and backpressure_burst FAIL - samples dropped when m_axis_tready deasserts >2 cycles.
E6.rationale: New simulation log shows test results; updates most recent action.

E6.value: Backpressure handling needs improvement (10/12 PASS, backpressure_random/burst FAIL).
E6.rationale: New simulation log indicates partial failure, updating project status.

E6.value: Simulated tb_axis_fft to verify backpressure behavior; 10/12 PASS, FAIL on backpressure_random and backpressure_burst due to samples dropped when m_axis_tready deasserts >2 cycles.
E6.rationale: Record test attempt and outcome from new simulation log.

E7.value: Ran simulation tb_axis_fft; 12/12 PASS including backpressure_random and backpressure_burst after adding skid buffer on output.
E7.rationale: New simulation shows all tests pass after adding skid buffer.

E7.value: Backpressure handling resolved (12/12 PASS after adding skid buffer).
E7.rationale: Simulation indicates backpressure tests now pass.

E7.value: Added skid buffer on output of axis_fft wrapper; simulation tb_axis_fft: 12/12 PASS including backpressure_random and backpressure_burst.
E7.rationale: Record new attempt to improve backpressure handling.

E7.value: Simulation shows no mismatch (max error 2.1e-4), indicating bit-reversed output ordering is present.
E7.rationale: New simulation passes all tests, contradicting claim that bit-reversed output ordering is missing.

E8.rationale: New synthesis report shows timing failure and resource utilization.
